description: Entity class representing the history of status changes for insurance claims, including references to the claim, actor, status updates, notes, and timestamp.

classes.name: ClaimStatusHistory
classes.description: Entity class that records each status change of an insurance claim, including who performed the change, the previous and new status, notes, and timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this claim status history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this record.

methods.name: getClaim
methods.description: Returns the claim associated with this status change.

methods.name: setClaim
methods.description: Associates this status change with a specific claim.

methods.name: getActor
methods.description: Returns the user who performed the status change.

methods.name: setActor
methods.description: Sets the user as the actor who changed the claim status.

methods.name: getFromStatus
methods.description: Gets the previous status of the claim before this change.

methods.name: setFromStatus
methods.description: Sets the previous status of the claim.

methods.name: getToStatus
methods.description: Gets the new status of the claim after this change.

methods.name: setToStatus
methods.description: Sets the new status of the claim.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Returns any notes associated with this status change.

methods.name: setNotes
methods.description: Sets notes related to the status change.

methods.name: getChangedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the status change occurred.

methods.name: setChangedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for when the status change occurred.
